Name: Purifying Salt
Description:
Ability id 272 (verified via cfg.GetText(TextName.AbilityNames) against the real ROM, not guessed; no existing ability-master-table entry before this package). Byte-for-byte transcription of ABZB's own verified ARM research (Purifying Salt.xlsx). Two independent timing-slot functions, both re-disassembled cleanly against the real Battle.cro with every branch landing on a real instruction boundary and every BL target confirmed as a live function with many independent callers elsewhere in this exact ROM (0x87B58 GetBattleVar: 2070 callers; 0x82D44 status-apply helper: 185 callers, and its own function body starts with a clean PUSH right after a 'POP.../NOP' boundary; 0x83108 power/stat multiplier dispatcher: 34 callers, independently confirmed as this ROM's real damage/stat-multiplier engine by the already-shipped, native-verified Fickle Beam proc per walkthrough.md). No PC-relative literal loads in either function, so CodeRelocator.RebaseCode's branch-only fixups are sufficient - no CudChew-style ADD-PC fix needed. No deviation from the donor bytes was required for this ability.

Timing 0x7C ('Immune to Status conditions'): if self is the intended target of the status-infliction attempt (GetBattleVar(0x4)==self), calls the status-apply helper (0x82D44) with r1=1 (negate/cancel) and r0=0x46 (status-effect code), blocking the status.

Timing 0x4A ('Half Damage from Ghost'): if self is the defender (GetBattleVar(0x4)==self) and the attacking move's type is Ghost (GetBattleVar(0x19)==7), applies a Q12.4 0x800 (=0.5x) multiplier via the confirmed-live 0x83108 dispatcher with r0=0x39 (the same 'operation code' Ruin Abilities uses for its own stat/damage multiplier call, and the same one Fickle Beam's native 2.0x power double uses via the same dispatcher, just a different r1 multiplier).
